origin: Own hardware of the maintainer: the TrueNAS host truenas, recorded on 2026-10-16 at 14:52 UTC through the read-only wrapper psa-agent with the call of the tool. Three NetApp X371 SAS SSDs behind an LSI SAS2308 HBA (driver mpt2sas) and one Samsung SATA SSD on the AHCI controller of the board, smartmontools 7.4. Replaces the recording of 12:09 UTC the same day, which was made with -n standby for every drive
collected_with: the read-only wrapper psa-agent on the host: smart-scan, smart DEVICE TYPE (the call of the tool), lsblk
controller: LSI SAS2308 HBA, driver mpt2sas, for sda, sdc and sde; Intel AHCI for sdd

files.command: lsblk as JSON through the read-only wrapper psa-agent
